message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features a white background with a large red "TEMPO" masthead at the top. Above it, black text reads "UANG SUAP DI KANTOR HOTMA". Below the masthead, "EDISI 5-11 AGUSTUS 2013" and "MENDADAK JOKOWI" are printed in black.

The central scene depicts five men as cartoon figures engaged with musical equipment. In the bottom right, a smiling man in a light blue collared shirt holds a microphone. Behind him, a man in a white shirt plays two tall drums. To the left, a man in a purple jacket and blue pants plays a red keytar. In the center, a large black speaker cabinet sits on a grey wooden cart with two black wheels. Emerging from a hole in the speaker, a man in a green shirt and yellow headband jumps forward while playing a white electric guitar. Behind him, another man in a brown uniform plays an orange bass guitar.

Connecting these elements are red and black electrical cords coiling across the floor. In the bottom left, a barcode, price "RP 33.000", and publication details are visible.
